articles.title: Snake Blood Holds a Secret Weapon Against Snakebites!
articles.summary: Scientists found that rattlesnake blood has special proteins that can stop venom. Mixing a few together made a super-strong antivenom—10 times stronger than the old one! This could save thousands of lives.

articles.title: Taylor Swift Fans Shook the Ground—Scientists Measured It!
articles.summary: When 70,000 Swifties danced at a concert, they made the ground shake like a tiny earthquake! Scientists study these human-made tremors to build safer buildings and understand how people move at big events.

articles.title: NASA's Genesis Spacecraft Crashed—But Scientists Still Saved the Samples!
articles.summary: In 2004, NASA's Genesis spacecraft crashed in Utah because its parachute didn't open. The solar wind samples shattered, but scientists managed to recover some. It was NASA's first sample-return mission since Apollo!
